title: Reserve the adaptive banner dock across every free-app surface
prompt: Read README.md, AGENTS.md, docs/PILOT100_BACKLOG.md, docs/DESIGN_RECONCILIATION.md and the referenced frozen docs/design sources. Rules Spec v1 is canonical: Repair/Sabotage each end at six, one direct player-card vote, private Route/Gate inputs and authoritative deterministic outcomes. The five-point/Witness/demo scripts and completed T01-T10 APIs are historical; preserve their existing tests/API compatibility without using them as new game rules. Edit only owned paths and use existing dependencies unless manifest ownership explicitly permits reviewed additions. Keep engine production pure and do not read credentials, provision services, deploy, publish PRs or start agents. Use original synthetic fixtures and verified assets only. Run scoped tests/lint/typecheck and npm run check; report outcomes and contract changes. Implement the app-root dock layout consumed by the new shell: one platform-owned banner host, its adaptive height plus bottom safe area reserved before first render, navigation above it, and gameplay/modals/cinematics within the remaining viewport. The dock must not fade or remount on match entry or phase changes. Remove Ads removes it through verified entitlement. A blocking game modal makes the game background inert while keeping the platform ad dock visibly separate and uncovered, under the approved focus/input boundaries. Use injected host/layout fixtures for loaded, failed and empty states; no SDK or production ad-unit ID is required. Web no-op mode uses explicit zero-ad layout rather than fake advertising.
acceptance: The same dock host stays mounted across Home, lobby, reveal, match, City Moment, modal and match-entry transitions.
Ad load, failure and refresh do not move reserved controls/navigation or hide vital tap targets.
Safe-area, 320px and large-text fixtures keep gameplay/close controls reachable without covering the platform dock.
Verified entitlement changes remove reserved ad space through the documented layout transition without fabricating a purchase.
